name: Multivariable Calculus
summary: Calculus of functions of several variables: partial derivatives, gradients, optimisation with constraints and multiple integrals.

topics.name: Vectors and the geometry of space: dot and cross products, lines and planes
Vector-valued functions, space curves, arc length and curvature
Functions of several variables (multivariable calculus): graphs, level sets, limits and continuity
Differentiability, linearisation and the multivariable chain rule
Local extrema, the second-derivative test and optimisation
Double integrals over general regions; polar coordinates
Triple integrals in cylindrical and spherical coordinates
Change of variables and the Jacobian
Applications: mass, centre of mass, moments and probability
